description: Comparing reported CBG membrane binding-site affinities against the plasma steroid-binding affinity, and drawing the integrated CBG pathway schematic
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mp

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# PANEL A: reported affinities on a common pKd axis
# Kd in molar. pKd = -log10(Kd). Higher = tighter.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
rows = [
 # label, Kd (M), category, pmid
 ("CBG : cortisol\n(plasma, haCBG)",      0.7e-9,  "steroid",  "19643161"),
 ("CBG : cortisol\n(RCL-cleaved, laCBG)", 6.3e-9,  "steroid",  "27411675"),
 ("CBG : progesterone\n(plasma)",         1.0e-8,  "steroid",  "19643161"),
 ("Membrane site, decidual\nendometrium", 1.0e-10, "membrane", "3395639"),
 ("Membrane site,\nhuman prostate",       8.7e-7,  "membrane", "3010286"),
]
lab  = [r[0] for r in rows]
pKd  = [-np.log10(r[1]) for r in rows]
cat  = [r[2] for r in rows]
pm   = [r[3] for r in rows]
col  = ["#2166ac" if c=="steroid" else "#b2182b" for c in cat]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(15.5, 5.6),
                         gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.0, 1.25]})
ax = axes[0]
y = np.arange(len(rows))[::-1]
ax.barh(y, pKd, color=col, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.7, height=0.62)
for yy, p, k, pid in zip(y, pKd, [r[1] for r in rows], pm):
    ax.text(p+0.12, yy, f"Kd = {k:.2g} M  (PMID {pid})",
            va="center", fontsize=8.6)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(lab, fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("pKd  (-log10 Kd, higher = tighter binding)", fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(5.5, 11.6)
ax.set_title("A. CBG steroid binding is reproducible;\nCBG membrane binding is not",
             fontsize=11, loc="left")
# span showing the discrepancy between the two membrane reports
mem = [p for p,c in zip(pKd,cat) if c=="membrane"]
ax.axvspan(min(mem), max(mem), color="#b2182b", alpha=0.10, zorder=0)
ax.annotate("", xy=(min(mem), 0.62), xytext=(max(mem), 0.62),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color="#b2182b", lw=1.6))
ax.text(np.mean(mem), 0.95,
        f"{max(mem)-min(mem):.1f} log units\n({10**(max(mem)-min(mem)):.0f}-fold) apart",
        ha="center", fontsize=9, color="#b2182b", fontweight="bold")
ax.legend(handles=[mp.Patch(facecolor="#2166ac", edgecolor="k", label="Steroid binding by CBG"),
                   mp.Patch(facecolor="#b2182b", edgecolor="k", label="Reported CBG membrane site")],
          fontsize=8.5, loc="lower right")
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# PANEL B: integrated pathway schematic
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
bx = axes[1]; bx.set_xlim(0,10); bx.set_ylim(0,10); bx.axis("off")
bx.set_title("B. Where SERPINA6 acts: synthesis, buffering, targeted release",
             fontsize=11, loc="left")

def box(x, y, w, h, txt, fc, fs=8.4, bold=False):
    bx.add_patch(mp.FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.12",
                 facecolor=fc, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.9))
    bx.text(x+w/2, y+h/2, txt, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fs,
            fontweight="bold" if bold else "normal")

def arrow(x1,y1,x2,y2,c="black",st="-|>",lw=1.5,ls="-"):
    bx.annotate("", xy=(x2,y2), xytext=(x1,y1),
        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle=st, color=c, lw=lw, linestyle=ls,
                        shrinkA=2, shrinkB=2))

# compartment bands
bx.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((0.1,7.2), 9.8, 2.6, facecolor="#fdf2e9", edgecolor="none"))
bx.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((0.1,3.6), 9.8, 3.3, facecolor="#eaf2fb", edgecolor="none"))
bx.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((0.1,0.2), 9.8, 3.1, facecolor="#eef7ee", edgecolor="none"))
for yy, t in [(9.55,"Hepatocyte  (site of synthesis)"),
              (6.62,"Blood plasma  (site of function)"),
              (3.02,"Peripheral tissue  (site of release)")]:
    bx.text(0.3, yy, t, fontsize=9, style="italic", color="#444")

box(0.5, 8.3, 1.9, 0.85, "KLF15", "#ffd59e", bold=True)
box(3.0, 8.3, 2.3, 0.85, "SERPINA6\ntranscription", "#ffd59e")
box(5.9, 8.3, 1.9, 0.85, "CBG\n405 aa", "#ffd59e")
box(8.2, 8.3, 1.5, 0.85, "secreted", "#ffd59e")
arrow(2.4,8.72,3.0,8.72); arrow(5.3,8.72,5.9,8.72); arrow(7.8,8.72,8.2,8.72)
bx.text(1.45, 7.75, "180.7 TPM liver = 88.6% of total GTEx signal",
        ha="left", fontsize=8, color="#8a5a00")

box(0.6, 5.1, 2.6, 1.35, "haCBG  (S state)\nRCL exposed\nKd ~ 0.7 nM", "#aecde3", bold=True)
box(6.6, 5.1, 2.8, 1.35, "laCBG  (R state)\nRCL inserted\nKd ~ 6 nM", "#f4b8b0", bold=True)
box(3.6, 5.35, 2.6, 0.85, "neutrophil elastase\ncleaves Val344-Thr345", "#ffffff")
arrow(3.2,5.78,3.6,5.78,c="#b2182b"); arrow(6.2,5.78,6.6,5.78,c="#b2182b")
box(3.6, 3.95, 2.6, 0.78, "alpha-1-antitrypsin\n(SERPINA1, same locus)", "#ffffff")
arrow(4.9,4.73,4.9,5.35,c="#2166ac",st="-[",lw=1.8)
bx.text(0.6, 4.3, "~80% of circulating cortisol is CBG-bound; 5% free",
        fontsize=8.2, color="#1a4a73")
bx.text(6.6, 4.3, "cortisol released locally", fontsize=8.2, color="#8a1f17")

arrow(8.0,5.1,8.0,2.6,c="#b2182b",lw=1.8)
box(6.6, 1.7, 2.9, 0.9, "free cortisol -> GR / MR", "#bfe0bf", bold=True)
box(0.6, 1.7, 3.0, 0.9, "reported CBG membrane\nsites: unresolved", "#e8e8e8")
bx.text(0.6, 1.2, "no gene identity, Kd reports 8700-fold apart,\nno replication since 1995",
        fontsize=7.8, color="#555")
bx.text(4.2, 0.45, "Thermosensitive release: free cortisol roughly doubles\n"
                   "from 37 to 39 C (PMID 27411675)", fontsize=8.2,
        ha="center", color="#8a1f17",
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", fc="#fff3f0", ec="#b2182b", lw=0.8))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("Membrane-site Kd discrepancy: %.0f-fold between PMID 3395639 and PMID 3010286"
      % (8.7e-7/1.0e-10))
print("Prostate membrane Kd (8.7e-7 M) is %.0f-fold WEAKER than CBG:cortisol (0.7e-9 M)"
      % (8.7e-7/0.7e-9))
print("Decidual membrane Kd (1.0e-10 M) is %.1f-fold TIGHTER than CBG:cortisol"
      % (0.7e-9/1.0e-10))
print("haCBG -> laCBG affinity loss: %.1f-fold" % (6.3e-9/0.7e-9))
